skill.summary: Build production AI assistants with architecture, conversation design, testing, deployment, and monitoring guidance.

content.value_statement: Teams need reliable guidance for building conversational AI systems. This skill provides architecture, testing, deployment, and monitoring patterns for production assistants.
actual_capabilities: Designs AI assistant architectures with NLU, dialog management, context, and integration layers.
Outlines NLP pipelines for intent detection, entity extraction, sentiment analysis, and language handling.
Provides conversation-flow patterns for branching dialogs, clarification, confirmation, and task completion.
Describes LLM integration patterns, including provider setup, fallback handling, and function calling.
Recommends testing approaches for multi-turn conversations, safety responses, performance, and user simulation.
Covers deployment, scaling, monitoring, analytics, and continuous improvement workflows.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and examples, not a complete runnable assistant framework.
Code samples require adaptation before production use in a real application.
It does not train models or supply proprietary datasets.
Security, privacy, and compliance controls still need project-specific review.

use_cases.title: Design a Support Assistant
use_cases.description: Create a customer support chatbot architecture with intents, entities, escalation paths, and monitoring metrics.

use_cases.title: Plan Conversation Quality Tests
use_cases.description: Build test coverage for multi-turn flows, fallback behavior, context use, and safety responses.

use_cases.title: Prepare an LLM App for Launch
use_cases.description: Define deployment, scaling, analytics, and improvement loops for a production conversational application.

prompt_templates.title: Assistant Architecture Starter
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new assistant.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design an AI assistant for [domain]. Include core components, user goals, required integrations, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Conversation Flow Planner
prompt_templates.prompt: Create conversation flows for [assistant task]. Include intents, required entities, clarifying questions, fallback paths, and handoff rules.

prompt_templates.title: Testing Strategy Builder
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a testing plan for my AI assistant. Cover unit tests, conversation tests, safety cases, performance checks, and user simulation.

prompt_templates.title: Production Readiness Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced launch review for an LLM application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this AI assistant design for production readiness. Assess architecture, LLM integration, context handling, deployment, monitoring, and improvement loops.

output_examples.input: Design a banking support assistant for account questions and card issues.
output: Architecture outline with NLU, dialog management, policy controls, and integration boundaries.
Conversation flow covering authentication, account lookup, card replacement, escalation, and fallback handling.
Testing checklist for intent accuracy, sensitive data handling, and multi-turn context use.

output_examples.input: Create a launch checklist for a customer service chatbot.
output: Deployment plan with scaling, health checks, monitoring, and rollback considerations.
Analytics plan for fallback rate, resolution rate, latency, satisfaction, and escalation rate.
Continuous improvement loop using reviewed conversations, feedback, and retraining priorities.

best_practices: Start with clear user goals, domain boundaries, and measurable assistant success criteria.
Test complete conversations, not only individual prompts or single-turn responses.
Monitor fallback rates, latency, satisfaction, and error patterns after release.
anti_patterns: Launching without defined escalation paths for ambiguous, unsafe, or unresolved requests.
Treating LLM responses as trusted actions without validation, policy checks, or logging.
Ignoring conversation analytics after deployment instead of using them for improvement.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps plan AI assistants, chatbots, and LLM applications with production-focused design guidance.

faq.question: Does it include runnable application code?
faq.answer: It includes example patterns and snippets, but you must adapt them to your stack and requirements.

faq.question: Can it help with conversation design?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers intents, entities, dialog flow, clarification, context, fallback behavior, and handoffs.

faq.question: Does it support LLM provider integration planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes provider setup, fallback handling, response validation, and function-calling interfaces.

faq.question: How does it address testing?
faq.answer: It recommends unit, integration, conversation, performance, safety, and user simulation tests.

faq.question: Is it suitable for regulated applications?
faq.answer: It can support planning, but regulated products need separate privacy, security, and compliance review.
